name: Bad Bye
source:
The world collapsed. Cities emptied like broken veins. Those who remain trade in ghosts – and when the dead still have influence, you realize this dystopia runs on more than survival.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
